item.title: BlackRock Expands Tokenized Fund Strategy to Solana
item.summary: BlackRock has moved further into blockchain-based finance by filing to launch tokenized shares of a money market fund that would operate across Solana, Ethereum and Tempo. The initiative reflects growing institutional interest in using public blockchain networks to record ownership of traditional financial assets.
